evals.prompt: Panel-review the test strategy for the workbench upload pipeline.
evals.expected_output: Should convene the panel's expert lenses, produce findings attributed per expert, and emit the scoring-gate verdict (score with a Ready/Not-Ready call).
assertions: Covers the test strategy lenses: coverage, fixture quality, AC testability, regression discipline
Findings attributed to specific expert perspectives
Findings are specific to the submitted artifact, not generic
Emits a numeric score and an explicit gate verdict

baseline.note: Agent without the skill violates these assertions.

evals.prompt: Panel-review this strategy: mocks the seam under test, no fixtures, ACs untestable as written, no regression suite.
evals.expected_output: Should score the weak artifact below the gate threshold, return Not-Ready, and make every blocking finding actionable (what to change to pass).
assertions: Weaknesses identified against the panel's criteria
Gate returns Not-Ready for the weak artifact
Each blocking finding says what would make it pass

baseline.note: Agent without the skill violates these assertions.
